(Search snippet content — full article not retrieved; Times of Israel's own reporting language)
Iran confirmed that it had received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance but said it had not yet responded, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency.
Tasnim said Tehran continued to insist that seven conditions it had set for the United States be met. "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable"
